item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 AM 01 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #DinagatIslands(Loreto, Tubajon, Libjo), #ZamboangaCity, #DavaoOriental(CityOfMati, GovernorGeneroso, SanIsidro), #TawiTawi(Sibutu, Sitangkai) and #SurigaoDelSur(CityOfBislig) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, SanFrancisco) and #TawiTawi(Mapun) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
